:::{#sol-sum-over-set}

1.  Replace $x$ by each element of $A$ in turn, and add the results:

    $$
    \ba
    \sum_{x \in A} f(x)
    &= f(-1) + f(2) + f(5)
    \\ &= (-1)^2 + 2^2 + 5^2
    \\ &= 1 + 4 + 25
    \\ &= 30
    \ea
    $$

{{< slidebreak >}}

2.  In the order $5, -1, 2$, the terms are $25$, $1$ and $4$.
    Their total is $25 + 1 + 4 = 30$.
    The total is the same,
    because addition does not depend on the order of the terms.

:::
